entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arthur Herbert Tennyson Somers-Cocks, 6th Baron Somers,, was a British Army officer who was the 16th Governor of Victoria, from 1926 to 1931 and Administrator of Australia in 1930–31. He had a long involvement with the Boy Scout Movement and became the Boy Scouts Association's Chief Scout of the British Empire from 1942 until his death.
